desc:
The clock there seems to be a play on Okina's second theme. "Secret God Matara" is "秘神マターラ" (Hishin Matara), and the clock there says "秒針マターラ" (Byoushin Matara). The replacement means the hand on the clock that indicates seconds.

And I don't think there's anything more than a simple word swap? 🤨
